free_tier.stated: No free text allowance; the Orchestrator and Agent APIs bill per token, and the Search API bills $5.00 per 1,000 successful requests.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI-compatible clients and the Perplexity SDK
chaining: no standing free text tier; requests rejected with 429 are not billed

limits.value: per-token model rates and USD 5.00 per 1K Search API requests

identity_cost.detail: an account and API key from the console; no card gate stated on this page

reliability_note: tool fees and per-request charges are separate from token billing

evidence.proved: the API platform bills per token and per request with no free tier
